desc: Derive the structural characterization of adjacency, connected components, and shortest paths for the graph whose edges connect disjoint intervals.
Design an implicit/auxiliary graph construction that represents all relevant transitions without enumerating \(O(N^2)\) edges.
Find an algorithm for minimum vertex-weight path queries between arbitrary pairs, including disconnected cases, with suitable preprocessing and memory bounds.
Prove correctness of the structural reduction and weighted-distance computation, especially for paths involving overlapping intervals.
Implement the full stdin/stdout solution in Python, using coordinate compression, heaps/segment trees or other needed data structures, and validate complexity against the constraints.
